sources.title: Satsumasendai city announces Kaishin AI data-centre location agreement
sources.summary: The city and Kai Shin signed a location agreement on July 18, 2026 for an AI data-centre development inside Circular Park Kyushu. The plan starts with an initial demonstration unit and envisages staged commercial expansion to a cumulative 350 MW. Investment at that scale is planned at about JPY 850 billion, subject to change.
sources.date_semantics: July 18 is the exact location-agreement and project-announcement date. The agreement does not establish issued development consent, physical construction, completion or operation.

sources.title: Kagoshima prefecture identifies proposed Kaishin Satsumasendai AI Data Center
sources.summary: The prefecture identifies the proposed facility at Circular Park 1-1 inside Circular Park Kyushu. Kai Shin intends to supply AI and cloud computing customers including overseas hyperscalers. The plan begins with a small proof-of-concept unit, then expands according to demand toward 350 MW by March 2033. The roughly JPY 850 billion investment forecast applies at 350 MW and may change. Capacity is a planned project scale; the source does not label it IT load.
sources.date_semantics: Publication is July 24; the dated location agreement occurred July 18. March 2033 is a target, not achieved operation. The new-facility address appears in a separate establishment section as well as the company-office section.

sources.title: Kai Shin confirms Circular Park Kyushu development agreement
sources.summary: Kai Shin identifies the development within Circular Park Kyushu on the former Sendai thermal power station property. It describes preparations for early construction and opening following the July 18 agreement. Its cumulative 350 MW proposal is staged; the record does not establish completed works.
sources.date_semantics: July 18 is the agreement and announcement date, not construction commencement. Service-year forecasts attributed to newspaper coverage are not selected as primary milestones.

sources.title: Satsumasendai city adopts GX strategic-area development concept
sources.summary: The city reports continuing preparations to establish the AI data-centre development within Circular Park Kyushu, following the July location agreement. Its regional concept covers both the CPQ property and adjacent Karahama industrial land. September GX strategic-area designation concerns the wider industrial-development policy.
sources.date_semantics: October 8 is the dated publication of the city concept and planning-context report. It is not a construction observation, development permit or operating milestone; the project status remains announced from July 18.

sources.title: Satsumasendai GX strategic-area concept: CPQ land-use plan
sources.summary: The city concept allocates approximately 15 hectares of the roughly 25-hectare Circular Park Kyushu property to AI data-centre business and approximately 10 hectares to resource circulation. Detailed allocation is subject to coordination with relevant bodies. Adjacent Karahama industrial land is shown separately. The illustrated future campus is a concept, not evidence of construction.
sources.date_semantics: The two-page concept is labelled October 2026 and was released with the dated October 8 city page. October 8 is its publication date, not a survey or physical-work day. Land areas were visually read from page 2; the plan is not used as surveyed geometry.

sources.title: Circular Park Kyushu official property access map
sources.summary: The host company identifies Circular Park Kyushu at Circular Park 1-1, Satsumasendai. Its access section selects a named Google Maps feature for the CPQ property. This supplies a parent-property identity bridge; it does not identify the planned data-centre plot.
sources.date_semantics: Undated host-property identity and official map selection only; no AI project status observation inferred.

sources.title: Google Maps named Circular Park Kyushu host-property feature
sources.summary: The Google Maps feature selected by the official CPQ access page locates the named Circular Park Kyushu property. It is used as a labelled host-property marker, not as the AI data-centre plot or a surveyed boundary. The map label retains a legacy address component; the primary project records identify the host by name and current address.
sources.date_semantics: Undated named-property locator; retrieval is not a status observation.

sources.title: Kai Shin announces Craftia technical and power-infrastructure MOU
sources.summary: Kai Shin reports an August-end MOU with Craftia for the Satsumasendai AI data-centre project. Craftia is to support technical advice and coordination, examine participation in some EPC works, and participate in the planned high-voltage power-supply structure. These are intended arrangements, not achieved construction or delivered power.
sources.date_semantics: August 31 is the dated MOU report, referring to the agreement at August month-end. It supports continuing project planning; no construction milestone or secured operating capacity is inferred.
